subject: Pause onboarding timer while AP reviews invoice
messages:
From: Sana Gupta <sana.gupta@veridexhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Patel <priya.patel@veridexhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pause onboarding timer while AP reviews invoice

Hi Karthik —

Quick update from our finance team: the PO is approved but AP flagged a line-item discrepancy on the invoice and put payments on hold while they validate the vendor code. The purchasing team says this could take 4–6 business days.

We’re worried the onboarding timer and the pilot window will expire before AP clears the invoice. Is there any way Redwood can pause the onboarding timer or provide a short runway so we don’t lose progress? We’ve invested time in the integration and would like to keep the sandbox/live demo environment accessible.

I attached a screenshot from our payment portal (PO_status_screenshot.png).

Appreciate any help —
Sana
Buyer, Veridex Health
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Gupta <sana.gupta@veridexhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Patel <priya.patel@veridexhealth.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pause onboarding timer while AP reviews invoice

Hi Sana —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the screenshot — saw it. I can loop in CS and our approvals team to see what we can do quickly. Two options that we typically offer in situations like this:

- Pause the onboarding/demo timer for up to 7 days (we freeze the countdown while AP verifies the invoice).
- Issue a small, one-time trial credit (example: a 5k-token voucher) to preserve access while procurement clears the PO.

Neither requires legal sign-off; I just need approval from my manager to proceed. I’ve cc’d Lauren from CS to confirm operational details and Marissa for credit approval.

If you prefer, we can also put a short DocuSign acknowledgment in place that you’ll finalize the PO once AP clears it.

Will follow up shortly —
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sana Gupta <sana.gupta@veridexhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Patel <priya.patel@veridexhealth.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 May 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pause onboarding timer while AP reviews invoice

Hi all —

We can operationally support both approaches. Practical notes: 

- Pausing the onboarding timer: CS will freeze the tenant timer and ensure no automated reminders expire. We can do a single 7-calendar-day pause without impacting the environment snapshots.
- Trial credit: if you want uninterrupted access for heavy testing, we can issue a 5,000-token voucher that will apply to the sandbox only. Tokens do not roll over beyond the pause period.

If Veridex confirms which option you prefer, I’ll prepare the temporary-credit-form.pdf (attached) and we’ll queue the change. For the pause option I only need an email confirmation from Sana or Priya. For the voucher I’ll send a DocuSign link for a short acknowledgment (this helps with auditability on our side).

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Sana Gupta <sana.gupta@veridexhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Patel <priya.patel@veridexhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pause onboarding timer while AP reviews invoice

Hi team —

Approved. For Veridex (deal DW-4729) we will: 

1) Pause the onboarding/demo timer for 7 calendar days starting 2028-05-15.
2) Issue a 5,000-token sandbox voucher that will be active for the same 7-day window as a backup if Veridex needs to run heavier tests while AP resolves the invoice.

Conditions: once AP confirms the PO we expect the customer to notify us; if the PO does not materialize within 14 days we’ll reassess with RevOps. Please add a note to the HubSpot deal and upload the signed acknowledgment if DocuSign is used.

Karthik — please confirm the start date and update the HubSpot link: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/DW-4729. Lauren — please attach the temporary-credit-form.pdf to the deal and send the DocuSign link if Sana opts for the voucher.

Sana — happy to help keep things moving on your side. Let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Veridex_SOW_v2.pdf (for reference)
